title.zh: 改变 harness，保留你的工作方式
title.en: Change the harness, keep your workflow

sourceText:
Good morning from Vienna People of Pi🌞

Sunday meditations today from @badlogicgames and @mitsuhiko 

- change the harness, not your workflow 
- harness, know thyself 
- agency to build the features you need when you need them 

*clip from February with our friends @syntaxfm

zh.title: 让工具适应个人工作方式
zh.text: 两人以不同的工作习惯为出发点，讨论可定制的 harness。Pi 的扩展可以在当前会话中编写、重载，再通过即时反馈继续调整。

zh.title: 让 agent 知道如何扩展自己
zh.text: Armin 强调，Pi 的系统提示会引导 agent 阅读自身文档和示例，因此用户可以直接提出需求，让它创建可热重载的工具。

zh.title: 把反复操作变成专属界面
zh.text: 自定义代码审查命令可以弹出界面，让用户选择未提交修改、单个提交或相对主分支的审查范围。频繁重复的操作可以继续沉淀成扩展。

zh.title: 需要什么，就构建什么
zh.text: 两人以待办工具扩展为例，说明用户可以借助文档、示例和 API 自己补齐工作流所需功能，而不必完全依赖供应商的发布节奏。

en.title: Adapt the harness to the person
en.text: Different working habits motivate a customizable harness. Pi extensions can be written and reloaded in the current session, with immediate feedback guiding the next revision.

en.title: An agent that knows how to extend itself
en.text: Armin describes how Pi directs the agent to its own documentation and examples, helping it create tools that support hot reloading from a user’s request.

en.title: Turn repeated tasks into a custom interface
en.text: A review command can present choices for uncommitted changes, a single commit or changes against the main branch. Repeated interactions can become tailored extensions.

en.title: Build the features your workflow needs
en.text: A to-do extension illustrates how documentation, examples and APIs let users add capabilities themselves instead of depending entirely on a vendor’s release schedule.

segments.text: That's also how I think a coding harness should be.
segments.zh: 我认为编程 harness 也应该是这样。

segments.text: Like, he has a different workflow than I have.
segments.zh: 比如，他的工作流就跟我的不一样。

segments.text: And I want my coding harness with my agent, so to speak, to work according to his workflow.
segments.zh: 我可不希望自己的编程 harness 和 agent 非得按他的工作流来运作。

segments.text: Because that would be terrible. I hate his workflow.
segments.zh: 那太糟糕了。我讨厌他的工作流。

segments.text: So Pi is also a self-modifying, self-healing kind of harness, where the agent can write me ad hoc tools,
segments.zh: 所以 Pi 也是一种能自我修改、自我修复的 harness，agent 可以按需帮我写工具。

segments.text: and in the same session I can reload the updated version of that, and it sees if it fixed it or if it wrote it the correct
segments.zh: 在同一个会话里，我就能重载更新后的版本，让它检查有没有修好、写得对不对，

segments.text: way and so on.
segments.zh: 诸如此类。

segments.text: And I can give feedback immediately.
segments.zh: 我也能马上给出反馈。

segments.text: And I...
segments.zh: 而且我……

segments.text: What I think is, like, what is really fascinating to see, like, how Pi works is that the system prompt is tiny.
segments.zh: 我觉得 Pi 特别有意思的一点，是它的系统提示词非常短。

segments.text: I think it's under 1,000 tokens. I'm actually not sure.
segments.zh: 我记得不到 1,000 token，不过不太确定。

segments.text: And 25%, I guess, of the system prompt is the manual for Pi to read its own manual.
segments.zh: 其中大概有四分之一，是在告诉 Pi 如何阅读自己的使用手册。

segments.text: And so when I tell it, like, hey, we need to build this thing, it, like, I don't have to tell it what Pi is.
segments.zh: 所以我跟它说“我们要做这个东西”时，不用先解释 Pi 是什么。

segments.text: It's sort of like, oh, here are some examples to read this, right?
segments.zh: 它就会知道：“哦，这里有些例子，可以先读一下。”

segments.text: And so it's building its own tools, and it understands how to build these tools to be hot reloadable too.
segments.zh: 它会自己构建工具，也知道怎样让这些工具支持热重载。

segments.text: It's just really interesting.
segments.zh: 这真的很有意思。

segments.text: A Pi extension can bring up UI, right?
segments.zh: Pi 扩展还可以调出界面，对吧？

segments.text: And so I have a custom review command that works exactly like I want the review to be.
segments.zh: 我有个自定义审查命令，完全按我想要的方式做代码审查。

segments.text: Like, it looks exactly for the things that I want.
segments.zh: 它只检查我关心的那些东西。

segments.text: But I don't have to tell it, like, hey, please review the change versus the main branch.
segments.zh: 而且不用每次都跟它说：“请审查相对于主分支的修改。”

segments.text: It's kind of like, hey, review.
segments.zh: 我只要说：“审查一下。”

segments.text: And then it comes up a menu that's like, okay, how do you want me to review it?
segments.zh: 它就弹出一个菜单，问：“你想让我怎么审查？”

segments.text: Is it, like, uncommitted changes?
segments.zh: 看还没提交的修改？

segments.text: Is it as a single commit?
segments.zh: 还是看某一次提交？

segments.text: Is it a commit against the main thing?
segments.zh: 还是跟主分支比较？

segments.text: And it's UI that sort of auto-populates.
segments.zh: 这些选项会自动填到界面里。

segments.text: And if I don't like how it behaves, then I go to Pi and say, like, hey, actually, I keep doing this and this.
segments.zh: 如果我不喜欢它的行为，就跟 Pi 说：“我总是在重复这些操作。”

segments.text: Can we have a custom UI component for it?
segments.zh: 能不能专门做个界面组件？

segments.text: And it will just appear magically in the thing.
segments.zh: 然后它就像变魔术一样出现在里面了。

segments.text: And that, to me, is really the interesting part.
segments.zh: 对我来说，这才是最有意思的部分。

segments.text: It's like it becomes super malleable and adjusts to that without me having to jump for hoops.
segments.zh: 它变得特别容易定制，能适应我的需要，不用我绕一大圈。

segments.text: Like, the Claude Code team has released a new to-do tool, like, a couple of days ago.
segments.zh: 比如，Claude Code 团队前几天刚发布了一个新的待办工具。

segments.text: Armin rebuilt that as an extension to buy Pi in, what was it?
segments.zh: Armin 把它重新做成了 Pi 扩展，花了多久来着？

segments.text: I don't know.
segments.zh: 我也说不准。

segments.text: An hour?
segments.zh: 一个小时？

segments.text: Yeah.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.text: Something.
segments.zh: 差不多吧。

segments.text: So I don't have to wait for my coding harness producer or vendor to add a feature I need for my workflow.
segments.zh: 所以，我不用等编程 harness 的厂商把我工作流需要的功能加进来。

segments.text: I just tell Pi, build me this.
segments.zh: 我直接跟 Pi 说：“帮我做这个。”

segments.text: You just add it.
segments.zh: 直接加上就行。

segments.text: It reads for documentation, which is just marked on files with examples and API descriptions.
segments.zh: 它会读文档，也就是包含示例和 API 说明的 Markdown 文件。

segments.text: And then it builds the thing for me.
segments.zh: 然后帮我把东西做出来。

segments.text: And I think that has value, at least as an experiment.
segments.zh: 我觉得这有价值，至少作为一种实验是这样。

segments.text: Yeah, yeah.
segments.zh: 对，对。

segments.text: Also, I got Doom running that way, so that's nice.
segments.zh: 而且，我还用这种方式把 Doom 跑起来了，挺好。

segments.text: Yeah.
segments.zh: 对。
